name: DK Engineering
verdict: Owned by D.K. Engineering (Holdings) Ltd, majority-owned by James Roderick Cottingham. Nothing found.
note: Rating note: DK Engineering is a British Ferrari sales, restoration and servicing business founded in 1977 by David and Kate Cottingham and run by their family; James Cottingham, its managing director, races the #91 'Manthey DK Engineering' Porsche in the 2026 WEC. Its brand is a trade mark of D.K. Engineering (Holdings) Ltd, whose active person with significant control is James Roderick Cottingham (more than 50% but less than 75% of shares and voting rights, Companies House). No state stake and no human-rights finding against the company were identified.
